messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Hosting selection — security thresholds that push to Private (post-demo)

Hi Samira / Jason,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciate the candid discussion on throughput and the compliance bar you need to meet. Quick recap and a couple of clarify items that will determine whether Hosted / Dedicated will suffice, or if HelioBank will need a Private VPC/on-prem deployment: 

Key gating items you mentioned on the call:
- SSO: must integrate with your IdP via SAML 2.0 and support SCIM for user provisioning.
- Keys: customer-managed KMS + HSM-backed key option for model encryption at rest and key wrapping.
- Logging & retention: WORM-style audit logs with 7 years retention for selected transaction types and exportable audit bundles for auditors.
- Data residency: production inference hosted within us-east-1, with a plan for air-gapped review if we go on-prem.

Two clarifying asks before we do an internal fit assessment: 
1) On KMS/HSM — is the requirement that Redwood *cannot* manage the tenant key material (i.e., you need full customer key custody), or would a Redwood-hosted envelope key with HSM-backed root be acceptable if we provide strong attestations?
2) For logs — is 7 years retention required for *all* inference logs, or only for admin/audit traces tied to user actions and model decisions?

If you can reply with one-line answers to the two bullets above, I’ll run this past Karthik (solutions) and Monica (security/compliance) and circle back with a recommended hosting path and estimated lift.

Attachments: I’ve included a short template we usually ask customers to populate (HelioBank_security_requirements_2026.xlsx) — fills in things like retention windows, encryption scope, and acceptable auth flows.

Next step (proposed): I’ll schedule a 30-min technical sync this week after I hear back to validate the KMS/HSM model and log export cadence.

Thanks,
Alex

On Mon, Jul 6, 2026 at 8:02 AM Alex Martinez <alex@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciate the candid discussion...

Alex — quick answers inline.
1) Keys: We require customer key ownership for production workloads. That means control of the root/master keys in our KMS. If Redwood offers an HSM-backed importable key or a bring-your-own-key (BYOK) flow with attestable HSM, that would be acceptable; we cannot rely on a purely Redwood-managed tenant key.
2) Logs: 7 years retention applies to audit logs tied to transaction metadata and admin actions; full inference payload retention is not required by default but we need the ability to export anonymized traces for model-quality audits.

Additional detail that matters for the hosting decision:
- We operate under a federal financial regulator; therefore, any external service handling crypto material must provide FIPS-validated HSM attestations (or allow on-prem HSM integration).
- For Private vs Dedicated: Dedicated might work if Redwood can provide the BYOK + HSM attestation and a contractual log-retention SLA with export tooling. If not, Private (VPC or on-prem) is the only path.

I’ll attach the internal security checklist for reference — Samira will surface the specific FIPS requirements from compliance later today.

—Jason
Jason Lee

Subject: Next steps & recommended hosting path for HelioBank

Samira / Jason — thanks for the quick answers and Jason for confirming the FIPS/HSM constraint. Quick summary and recommended path so we’re aligned: 

Summary of constraints that push to Private: 
- Mandatory customer key ownership (BYOK with importable key material into an HSM) + FIPS attestations.
- Contractual 7-year retention for admin/audit logs with exportable WORM-compatible bundles.

Recommendation (based on current platform capabilities):
- Preferred path: Redwood Dedicated with BYOK + HSM attestation add-on *if* our security team can produce the required FIPS attestation and we can contract the 7-year log retention SLA. This would minimize infra overhead for HelioBank while meeting key requirements.
- Fallback / guaranteed path: Private VPC (managed Private) or on-prem deployment — if the attestation or BYOK import is not feasible within your timeline, Private will give HelioBank full control and satisfy compliance.

Proposed next steps (action owners and timing):
1) Redwood (Karthik + Monica) to confirm BYOK/HSM import feasibility and estimate (internal): due 2026-07-08 EOD.
2) HelioBank (Samira) to share compliance language for FIPS requirements and any minimal evidence needed for audit: due 2026-07-08 EOD.
3) Redwood to draft a Dedicated + BYOK commercial term and a Private deployment SOW option for comparison: due 2026-07-12.
4) Technical sync (30 min) to walk the BYOK flow and log-export: propose 2026-07-13 — Alex to send invite once Karthik confirms feasibility.

If this matches your expectations I’ll lock the dates and start the internal pricing exercise for the Dedicated + BYOK add-on. Happy to discuss alternatives if your compliance team has additional constraints.

Best,
